title: harveya purpurea subsp. sulphurea
intro: Harveya purpurea subsp. sulphurea, commonly known as the Sulphur Harveya, is a flowering plant species. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its potential health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Sulphur Harveya include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its use in treating conditions like bronchitis and sore throats. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although further research is necessary to confirm its efficacy and safety.
